pageDescription: Programs that start when you sign in, read from the registry, the Startup folder and Task Scheduler. Disabling an entry does not uninstall the program; the impact is estimated from the app name.
bootTraceAnalyzing: Reading the event log of the last boot
bootTraceNeedsAdmin: The timings of the last boot can only be read with administrator rights.
bootTraceNotAvailable: Boot timings are not available on this system.
bootTraceSummary_one: Full boot in {{total}}, of which {{apps}} for startup apps; {{n}} app measured.
bootTraceSummary_other: Full boot in {{total}}, of which {{apps}} for startup apps; {{n}} apps measured.
bootTraceSavings_one: Disabling {{n}} high-impact app can shorten the boot by about {{time}}.
bootTraceSavings_other: Disabling the {{n}} high-impact apps can shorten the boot by about {{time}}.
bootTraceMore: {{count}} more apps with a shorter delay are not shown.
chartBootTimeImpact: Delay compared with the slowest app
chartNoPerAppData: The last boot has no per-app timings.
emptyStateTitle: No startup programs in the locations read
emptyStateDescription: The registry, the Startup folder and Task Scheduler contain no startup entries.
errorFailedToLoad: Could not read the startup programs.
errorFailedToEnable: Could not enable {{name}}: administrator rights may be needed.
errorFailedToDisable: Could not disable {{name}}: administrator rights may be needed.
errorFailedToRemove: Could not remove {{name}}: administrator rights may be needed.
confirmRemoveDescription: The startup entry is deleted and the program no longer starts at sign-in. The program stays installed. To get the entry back, it has to be recreated by hand.
staleNote: The program it points to is no longer installed, so the entry starts nothing.
